plan_written_note: plan_written_utc in the receipt is read from this file's own filesystem mtime (os.stat) at run time, not a hand-written value -- a hand-written timestamp in this file could be wrong or fabricated and is not used. This worktree does not commit, so 'unchanged since plan_written_utc' means unchanged on disk, not git-committed.
history: Round 1: initial plan and measurement. Round 2: revised after review (added amendment forms, 10-K completeness check, post_close session split, created_at window filter, log-relative price-step detector, corporate-action step matching). Round 3: revised again after review (removed the hand-written plan_written_utc in favour of a stat-derived value; added filings_identity_breaks for XOM and DKNG). Because the plan was revised after seeing round-1 and round-2 results, it is not preregistered.
symbols_filings_news_rationale: 10 large-cap constituents present on EDGAR and continuously listed 2016-2026, plus 10 small/mid-cap names with heavier retail/algorithmic-news coverage and more volatile filing cadence (SPACs, recent IPOs, meme-stock names); mixes long-tenured issuers with names that IPO'd or were renamed inside the window so filing/news availability at the edges of 2016-2026 is exercised.
symbols_vintage_prices_rationale: 5 large-cap symbols with a known forward stock split inside 2016-2026 (AAPL 4:1 2020-08-31; AMZN 20:1 2022-06-06; GOOGL 20:1 2022-07-18; NVDA 4:1 2021-07-20 and 10:1 2024-06-10; TSLA 5:1 2020-08-31 and 3:1 2022-08-25), so raw-vs-adjusted bar divergence around a corporate action is directly observable.
filings_source: data.sec.gov submissions JSON per CIK (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK{10-digit}.json), ticker-to-CIK mapping from https://www.sec.gov/files/company_tickers.json

filings_identity_breaks.note: Symbols where www.sec.gov/files/company_tickers.json's current ticker->CIK mapping points to a distinct, separately-registered CIK from the one that filed most of the symbol's 2016-2026 history (a holdco reorg under Rule 12g-3, evidenced by an 8-K12B on the current CIK). Discovered by cross-checking data.sec.gov's full text search (efts.sec.gov) for each symbol's own company name against its 10-K filers. These symbols are excluded from the 'overall' filings totals (their current-CIK filing count is not representative coverage); each is also probed explicitly on its historical_cik, labelled historical_cik_probe, not merged into per_symbol or overall totals.

news_weeks_sampled.note: one fixed 7-day week per calendar year, ISO week containing the 2nd Monday of March, chosen without inspecting any news content before the plan was frozen

vintage_prices_source: alpaca-py 0.44.0 StockHistoricalDataClient (bars, feed=sip, adjustment=raw and adjustment=all) and CorporateActionsClient (/v1/corporate-actions)

env_files.note: Symbolic env-var names an operator exports before running measure.py; resolved with os.path.expandvars. No literal filesystem path is committed here (see scripts/validate.py PRIVATE_CONTENT).
